hard_gates.action: category fails regardless of the consensus sub-group's score, since consensus is the one part of this category this project has already accepted as structurally hard to close for free
hard_gates.condition: relative valuation multiples (price_to_earnings, price_to_book, ev_ebitda) are below 90% even though market_data and financial_statements are both above their own thresholds

hard_gates.action: category is flagged failing even if historical depth is otherwise strong; stale live price data cannot be averaged away by good historical coverage
hard_gates.condition: no market_data value has been retrieved from exchange_market_data_feed in the last 5 trading days for an actively listed company

hard_gates.action: rejected at validation; dividend facts must trace to an actual announcement, never be inferred from a price change alone
hard_gates.condition: a dividend_per_share or payout figure is populated with no matching corporate_actions/disclosures announcement id

hard_gates.action: category fails outright; a multi-segment company cannot be treated as complete while silently dropping one segment's revenue line
hard_gates.condition: company_pack.reports_multiple_segments is true (multi-segment) AND segment_revenue is missing for any disclosed segment

hard_gates.action: rejected at validation; ownership must reconcile arithmetically, matching the project's existing practice of publishing ownership only when positions reconcile to 100% (docs/data/telecom-sector.md)
hard_gates.condition: sum of disclosed ownership_percentage across all holder rows for a period exceeds 100% or, once free_float is added, is inconsistent with it

hard_gates.action: rejected; every action must trace to the announcement that declared it
hard_gates.condition: a corporate action fact exists with no announcement_id linking it to a disclosures record

hard_gates.action: flagged failing regardless of historical density, since a live issuer that stops appearing in the feed is far more likely to indicate a broken connector than a genuinely silent company
hard_gates.condition: no announcement captured for an actively listed company in the trailing 180 days

hard_gates.action: category fails outright for that company even if other activated field_groups are strong, so one entirely-empty activated KPI group cannot be averaged away by a well-covered one
hard_gates.condition: the sector pack activates a field_group for this company but zero fields in it are populated across the trailing 4 quarters

hard_gates.action: overall readiness cannot be labeled ready; this is the contract's direct implementation of the anti-averaging principle named in the task ('a whole category cannot be near-zero even if others are strong'), and mirrors the existing project rule in docs/data/telecom-sector.md that 'the engine must not label the sector ready before the weighted score and all hard gates pass'
hard_gates.condition: sector_pack activates this category for a company and its score is materially near zero while financial_statements and profitability both pass their own thresholds

hard_gates.action: rejected; a composite score can never be computed from a partial input set with the gap silently zero-filled — it must be marked missing_formula_inputs_or_history as a whole instead
hard_gates.condition: a composite score (piotroski_f_score, altman_z_score, beneish_m_score) is populated while one of its declared component sub-scores is marked unavailable

hard_gates.action: that fact is excluded from its category's completeness numerator entirely (it does not count as populated) until the missing provenance is supplied — this is the single hard gate that enforces every other category's provenance_requirements block
hard_gates.condition: any published fact anywhere in the dataset is missing one of its own category's provenance_requirements.mandatory_fields

hard_gates.action: the fact is flagged stale and excluded from the 'currently fresh' completeness numerator, even though it remains visible as historical data with its staleness disclosed
hard_gates.condition: any published fact's age exceeds its own category's freshness_policy.max_age_before_stale_days
